title: Cardaclysm, card battler with optional undertale/deltarune inspiration
author: Timely_Spirit_9053
selftext:
Hello everyone, I have been working on directing a game for a few months now, I dont have any experience in game development but I do know what I envisioned, this game is heavily based on a world I have been writing about for under two decades and I have been experimenting various ways to try to release some form of content related to it.

  
As for what is AI, a lot of it is I will not lie, the designs however are not AI, some characters are not mine but I have received permission to feature them from their respective creators.

  
I am really thinking what else to really add here, but truth be told I am very nervous as I dont know what to expect, im not expecting too much other than maybe hopefully a "i had fun", this game is intended to be forever free, i will never charge ANYTHING for it!

If i forgot to include anything, please do forgive me, let me know what that is and I will include it immediately.

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/Timely_Spirit_9053 could you add more about how AI fit into your development process? Just mentioning that AI was used doesn't cut it. Under Rule 4, promotional posts need to contribute something by discussing how the game was actually made. Otherwise the sub gets buried in ads. If there's no update, this post may be removed.

replies.author: Timely_Spirit_9053
replies.body:
Of course, I will add what i type in here to the main post as well:

AI served as primary function to code, i wrote down a lengthy list of what I wanted it to do and instructed GPT to do so and an estimate of...5% of the time it did not do it quite as I envisioned although I blame mostly myself for possibly not detailing it exactly, AI went into rendering, backgrounds, creating sprites as well as animating a good amount of animations using Autospriter, for music, half of them are royalty free music that i found online, the other half were created via Suno.
